notes: Keltner Channel breakout (stop-order entry above/below the band, canceled if price falls back inside before filling) with two optional, OFF-by-default add-ons: a 200-EMA trend filter and a session-hours filter ('0930-1445', Mon-Fri). Both filters are toggled false by default so neither gates entries in the base config. IMPORTANT for translation: with all optional exits (useAtrStop, exitOnMidBand) also OFF by default, the ONLY way a position closes at default settings is the opposite-side entry reversing it (Pine's implicit reversal since pyramiding=0) -- there is no active stop-loss/take-profit at defaults. Stage 1 screen_source() passed on ADMIT because the code textually contains strategy.exit()/strategy.close() calls (gated behind the disabled flags), not because the default configuration has a real exit. Translator should decide whether to enable useAtrStop/exitOnMidBand or keep the reversal-only default -- flagging this explicitly since it's a real risk-management gap, not a screening bug. NIFTY demo chart (5-min) but no explicit intraday-only restriction; mechanism is timeframe-portable. 150 lines.
